description: This file defines the interface for the CompositeInput class in the device namespace, including its methods and associated constants, structured for managing COMPOSITE input sources.

classes.name: CompositeInput
classes.description: A class managing COMPOSITE Input sources, providing methods to get input status, select ports, and scale video.

methods.name: CompositeInput::getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CompositeInput.

methods.name: CompositeInput::getNumberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of COMPOSITE inputs.

methods.name: CompositeInput::isPresented
methods.description: Checks if the COMPOSITE input is presented.

methods.name: CompositeInput::isActivePort
methods.description: Checks if a given port is active.

methods.name: CompositeInput::isPortConnected
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is connected.

methods.name: CompositeInput::scaleVideo
methods.description: Scales the video to specified dimensions and position.
